text:
maria_cs: customer reported repeated duplicate generations after an SSE reconnect — they were charged twice for the same prompt. ticket #4562, escalated. can eng take a look?

sam_sre: thanks — can you paste a minimal repro and any request ids / headers from their client?

maria_cs: repro steps from customer (condensed):
1) open SSE connection to /v1/stream with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` and `X-Session-Token: sess-abc123`
2) request generation, wait for partial chunks, then kill TCP (client hard close) after first chunk
3) client immediately reconnects (no backoff) with same session token and resumes from offset 0 using `resume_token: rt-42` header
4) server returns repeated tokens and a full generation again — customer got charged twice.

maria_cs: their logs include these headers on reconnect: `x-session-token: sess-abc123`, `x-resume-token: rt-42`, `idempotency-key: none`

sam_sre: ok — two things to check: (A) are we treating resume as idempotent when client supplies no idempotency key? (B) any evidence the runtime replayed generation due to KV cache miss or race?

rod_runtime: looking at runtime traces for sess-abc123 — I see a session rollover at 2026-02-18T14:02:03Z where the session lease expired and a new worker picked up the session. On reconnect we accept the resume_token and kick off a new generation if the KV cache doesn't have the completed output keyed by (session, offset). That can cause duplicate generation.

julio_devex: customer should always send an idempotency-key for non-resume retries, but we still need server-side protections. Suggested short-term mitigation: if resume_token points to offset N and we already emitted tokens starting at N, ignore the resumed generation and return suffix from existing cache.

ingrid_product: how many duplicates did they see? is it a single user or broader? billing impact?

maria_cs: they reported ~12 duplicate full generations in the last hour across 3 user sessions. customer says they were billed each time.

billing_bot: @billing-team FYI customer claims duplicate charges from streaming reconnects. please advise on refund flow. ticket #4562 linked.

sam_sre: can you attach raw request IDs from their logs? I need `X-Request-Id` from before and after reconnect to correlate.

maria_cs: pasted two request ids: `req-20260218-8a1` (first connection), `req-20260218-8a2` (immediate reconnect). Also attaching server-side trace ids: `trace-9f` and `trace-a0`.

rod_runtime: thanks. looking at traces: both traces show generation pipeline ran end-to-end. The KV cache lookup did not find the completed sequence because the original worker wrote a transient key that expired on lease transfer. So replay happened.

rod_runtime: immediate fix plan: 1) quick guard in resume handler to check a persistent resume-index store (durable) before launching generation, 2) if resumed index already marked completed -> return cached output, 3) add soft debounce window to ignore immediate reconnects within 500ms of disconnect if no idempotency-key present.

julio_devex: suggested client guidance in the short term: add jittered backoff before reconnect and always include an idempotency-key for resumed flows. we'll add update to SSE best-practices doc.

ingrid_product: prioritize server fix — customer impact + billing. SLAs? put this as P1 for runtime team for the next patch.

rod_runtime: will open PR for the guard and durable resume-index today. I'll post links and a canary build.

maria_cs: billing wants list of duplicated req ids to process refunds. I'll collect and send. thanks everyone.

ops_incident_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1023 — duplicate-charge-on-sse-reconnect. assignees: rod_runtime, sam_sre.

rod_runtime: quick note for triage: we should also instrument metrics for `resume_replays` (counts where resume_token led to replay) and `resume_cache_miss` so we can alert on >5/min.

sam_sre: I'll add alert and temporary runbook step: if `resume_replays` spikes, flip a feature flag to force resume-check-only (no replay) while we patch.

maria_cs: customer notified about investigation and refund process. will update when refund completed.

rod_runtime: PR link (WIP): https://git.redwood/repo/runtime/pull/324 — implements durable resume-index check + 500ms reconnect debounce behind feature flag.

julio_devex: I'll draft a short support advisory and update SSE docs and sample JS client to include idempotency-key in resume flow.

maria_cs: closing loop here — appreciate the fast turnaround.
